test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: According to the passage, why do people feel autonomous?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. Because influences are invisible**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage explains that individuals **may feel autonomous while operating within invisible boundaries**, meaning they believe they are making independent choices because the factors influencing them are not obvious. (प्रभाव अदृश्य होने के कारण) • **Example:** A person might think they are freely choosing a product, but their decision has been shaped by subtle advertising and social norms they do not notice. • **Because influences are invisible** means people are often unaware of the social, technological, and cultural factors guiding their actions. (क्योंकि प्रभाव अदृश्य हैं) • **Example:** Many individuals feel they are acting independently, even though their aspirations are shaped by education systems and traditions from a young age. • This highlights how the perception of autonomy can exist alongside unnoticed influences. Therefore, the correct answer is- Because influences are invisible [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Due to lack of rules** (नियमों की कमी के कारण): Means there are no rules restricting choices. • **Example:** The passage does not mention a lack of rules as the reason for feeling autonomous. • **Due to economic equality** (आर्थिक समानता के कारण): Means everyone has the same economic status. • **Example:** Economic equality is not discussed in the passage as a factor for perceived autonomy. • **Because traditions are ignored** (क्योंकि परंपराओं को नजरअंदाज किया जाता है): Means people do not follow traditions. • **Example:** The passage mentions that traditions influence aspirations, not that they are ignored. 3f:Tefd, The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. They subtly guide preferences**.
